args.body:
Dear Valued Client,

Thank you for bringing this urgent issue to our attention. We understand the critical impact of the integration outage on your users and we apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Our team is treating this matter with the highest priority. We are currently investigating the root cause of the downtime and working diligently to restore full functionality as quickly as possible.

We will provide updates every 30 minutes until the issue is resolved. In the meantime, if you have any additional information about when the issue started or any error messages, please share them to help expedite the troubleshooting.

We sincerely apologize for this disruption and appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this urgently.

Best regards,
Morgan Lee
Support Team
